cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.successMessage: You’ve set your cookie preferences. Go back to the page you were looking at.
cookies.intro1: Cookies are small files saved on your phone, tablet or computer when you visit a website.
cookies.intro2: We use cookies to make this site work and collect information about how you use our service.
cookies.essentialIntro: Essential cookies keep your information secure while you use this service. We do not need to ask permission to use them.
cookies.analyticsIntro1: We use Google Analytics to understand how people use the pEPR regulator’s service. It helps us understand how you use the service and where we can make improvements.
cookies.analyticsIntro2: We do not collect or store your personal information. We do not allow Google to use or share our analytics data.
cookies.analyticsIntro3: Google Analytics cookies store information about:
cookies.analyticsList2: how long you spend on each page
cookies.analyticsList3: how you arrived at the site
cookies.analyticsList4: what you click on while you visit the site
cookies.analyticsList5: the device and browser you use
cookies.analyticsGaPurpose: Counts individual visits to the service
